article: Affine and projective transformations: homogeneous coordinates, graphics pipelines, and computer vision
scope: Corrected the Japanese source and completed full AI reviews of all twelve available language editions. Exact source and translation hashes, review date, scope, and AI limitations are recorded. Publication is pending.
findings: Removed the duplicate publication date and repaired unrelated internal links embedded in Japanese words.
Specified nonsingular projective matrices and homogeneous-coordinate scale equivalence; documented the W=0 limit.
Separated planar perspective rectification from lens distortion, qualified panorama stitching by camera-center assumptions, and clarified the view-frustum-to-screen projection pipeline.

post/affine-and-projective-transformatio.summary: Read the complete Arabic edition against the Japanese source and aligned its formulas and technical explanations. Corrected the matrix assumptions, homogeneous-coordinate equivalence, perspective division at W=0, affine shape wording, 3D projection pipeline, lens-distortion conflation, camera-center condition for panorama stitching, and duplicate date.
